metadata.description: The Macrothought method as installable departments. Verification, memory, decision and orchestration discipline, distilled from a working agent estate.

plugins.name: verification
plugins.description: Falsifiable checks and honest instrumentation. Auditing gates that cannot fail, sabotage and positive controls, chart integrity, the unknown-versus-zero rule, and release gate design.

plugins.name: second-brain
plugins.description: Durable machine-readable memory for agent estates. Department-organized notes, evidence-gated triage of machine suggestions, confidence tagging, and memory lint.

plugins.name: decision-discipline
plugins.description: Decisions that survive review. The relentless design interview, compiling recorded decisions into a citable doctrine, verdict-first answers, and a register of settled calls.

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Running many agents without losing the thread. Requirement ledgers, verify-audit-repair loops, context packs, and hygiene for concurrent and long-running agents.
